messages.subject: Italian-Thai Development | Major projects, stakeholder strategy and regional execution
messages.body:
Dear Italian-Thai Development Leadership Team,

Italian-Thai Development's portfolio of large infrastructure and engineering projects calls for strong execution not only in construction, but also across regulators, communities and institutional stakeholders.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities include government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate coordination, social performance and executive stakeholder strategy across a major mining operation.

I bring direct experience managing multi-agency approvals, formal commitments, official engagements and community-sensitive issues in a remote industrial setting. I also support governance around large-scale renewable energy and carbon-data systems. This gives me a practical perspective on the external conditions that protect project continuity and reputation.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional responsibilities across Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships or country leadership. I have attached an Italian-Thai Development-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
